tracking: ADR-0358 (lane E39) part 2: API-only by the lane brief (rule 3); the CMDB connector screen is for the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/cmdb/connectors: lists CMDB connectors with their posture (export only, egress allowed, air-gapped), credential user name and last run (never the secret)
gaps.POST /v1/cmdb/connectors: creates a CMDB connector (ServiceNow), disabled and export only
gaps.PUT /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/con: sets the instance, IRE source name, CI class per asset kind and the ownership read-back (a relaxation, step-up); moving the instance revokes the credential
gaps.PUT /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/cre: stores or rotates the CMDB integration credential (compare-and-set, step-up, reason)
gaps.DELETE /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/: revokes the CMDB credential: destroys the secret and disables the connector
gaps.PUT /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/ena: turns CMDB export on (step-up, reason, a live credential, not air-gapped) or off
gaps.POST /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/sy: pushes the AI asset inventory to the CMDB now (the scheduled sweep's function)
gaps.GET /v1/cmdb/connectors/:connectorId/lin: lists the exported configuration items and the ownership the CMDB reported (recorded, never applied)
